title: On the Hour or Half Past?

steps.body: Check the minute hand first: pointing to 12 means ":00" (on the hour); pointing to 6 means ":30" (half past). Then read the hour from the hour hand.

widget.successFeedback: Yes — minute hand at 12 means on the hour: 4:00.
widget.hourFeedback: The hour comes from the short hand, which is at 4: 4:00.
widget.minuteFeedback: 4:30 needs the minute hand at 6. Here it's at 12, so it's 4:00.

predict.prompt: Which hand do you check FIRST to know whether it is o'clock or half past?
predict.reveal: The long hand. Straight up at the 12 means o'clock; straight down at the 6 means half past. Check that first, then read which hour it is from the short hand.

explanationVariants: Minute hand at 6 means half past: 6:30.

widget.prompt: The hour hand points to 4 and the minute hand points to 12. What time is it?

options.feedback: That needs the minute hand at 6; this is 4:00.
The hour hand is at 4, so it's 4:00.
